changes.reason: Card page footnote 2: points continue "on all EMI transactions through American Express SafeKey" but not "on any EMI option selected from a merchant's website". SafeKey EMI, merchant-website EMI and terminal EMI all arrive on the EMI rail; the C3.1 context cannot tell them apart (D14b), so the rule stays info and the rail-EMI exclusion applies (may under-state, H2).

Card page footnote 2: points continue "on all EMI conversions done post purchase". Whether an EMI was converted after purchase or chosen at the merchant is not in the C3.1 context (D14b); info, the rail-EMI exclusion applies (may under-state, H2).

The card page (fetched 2026-11-06) names no Reward Multiplier rate for this card, and Amex India's notice (quoted by Business Today, 1 Sep 2026) says "Effective 30 September 2026, the Reward Multiplier program will be discontinued." An unverified 2X on a closed programme is removed (H2); Reward Multiplier spends earn the base rate.
